annual_compliance: Legal personality is granted by the Asamblea Nacional and is revocable for legislative non-compliance. No published annual filing deadline; the Interior Ministry registry monitors compliance.
Since 2024, OSFL must register in the Banco Central's RTBF transparency registry (beneficial owners) and file annual financial/AML reports. Sanctions for non-compliance; statutes govern associations.
FIPs must pay the annual tasa única (~USD 300) to the Registro Público via e-Tax 2.0 each year by 15 July, keep ledgers current, and notify the registry of changes. Non-payment forfeits legal status.

Foundations and associations renew chamber registration and file annual financials, board minutes and activity reports by ~31 March; fines apply for non-filing, prolonged inactivity risks cancellation.
Personality registers with SAREN; no published annual return deadline. Personality is revocable by administrative resolution for statutory breaches; obligations otherwise set by the statutes.
Foundations register in the SUIOS/SEPS transparency registry under the 2025 foundations law, filing annual activity and financial reports to the supervisory agency; fines apply for non-compliance.

Associations and foundations register with Minjus/SUNARP; annual general meeting and statutory compliance are mandatory. No fixed public filing deadline published; persistent breaches can trigger dissolution.

Ley 351 (2013) grants and registers personality for foundations and social orgs; the state can dissolve personality by resolution with asset seizure. No published annual return; duties set by internal statutes.

Non-profit companies must file an annual return with the DCRA at least once per year, made up to the AGM date, and keep registered-office records current; failure brings fines, persistent default risks strike-off.
Stichtings are created by notarial deed; no published annual return to the registry. Business activity requires SBN tax registration and annual tax filing. Foundation supervision is by the FIN.

Associations and foundations register at cartório; no published annual return to the registry. Accounting and tax duties run through a CNPJ with the Receita Federal; internal obligations follow the statutes.

OSC register with SENADIPJ under Ley 5833/2017; no fixed annual return deadline published. Entities receiving state funds must publish accounts to the Contraloría and face AIFAT audit; transparency bill pending.

Associations and foundations must inscribe in the DGR (Interior Ministry); no published annual return deadline. Annual general meeting and statutory duties follow the law; internal governance by statutes.
IGJ-registered associations and foundations must file approved financial statements annually, fully digital since mid-2026; non-filing brings fines and IGJ regularization windows for arrears.

OIP organizations must keep the MSGG OIP registry current and file annual activity and financial statements; sanctions include fines. Corporations and foundations file annual accounts to the registry.

NGOs under the 2013 NGO law file annual reports with financial statements to the Civil Affairs Department; non-reporting can lead to suspension. Private foundations and associations register with civil affairs.

General incorporated associations file an annual report with the supervising authority within 2 months of year-end (3 for foundations); persistent default risks deemed dissolution after 5 years, with fines for officers.

Incorporated associations and foundations file annual reports (activities and financials) with the court of incorporation; persistent non-filing brings fines under the Civil Code and risks revocation.

Foundations file an annual work report with the registration authority by early March; unapproved work invites a warning, and serious cases risk suspension of activities under the 2004 Foundation Regulation.
Foundations must submit the business plan, budget and financial statements to the competent authority within 30 days of year-end (early March); late filing is penalized with a deadline to correct.
